name: spark-stat
title: Spark Stat
description: A KPI card: a figure, its change as a coloured pill, and a sparkline of its recent shape. Uses namespace exports: SparkStat.Root.

docs.lead: A figure with its change against the previous period and a sparkline. The pill and the line take their colour from the trend.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A positive change turns the pill and line green. The trend follows the sign of delta unless you pass one.

examples.title: Down
examples.description: A negative change turns the pill and line red.

examples.title: Flat
examples.description: No change keeps the pill and line grey.

examples.title: No delta
examples.description: Leave delta out, or pass null, when there is no previous period to compare against. The pill is hidden and the line turns grey unless you pass a trend.

api.name: SparkStat.Root
api.description: The whole card, 96px tall. Size its width with className.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change against the previous period, in percent. Leave out, or pass null, for no pill

props.name: trend
props.description: Colours the pill and line. Pass your data source's own direction when it has one
